svg.text: Conceptual process flow and native control pathways | public process relationships only
One permitted completed stroke consumes one feed token and produces one part; geometry is conceptual.
29 degC nominal; coolant demand removes die heat
CW RETURN / heat removed from die
Pump input + bearing dissipation heat the oil; lumped cooler rejects heat to ambient.
Oil branches are lumped model relationships, not hydraulic pipe sizing or a resolved reservoir inventory.
Feed-complete latch; no stroke without its material token
Dashed arrows: measured PV -> controller -> final element. PV source is an internal physical signal, not another recorded tag.

PERMISSIVES / STOP / RESTART / MATERIAL AND ENERGY NOTES
Run gate: lube pressure >=2 bar; buffer >=0.15 m; die <=80 degC; cycle work <=2500 J; pitch inside 50..150 mm.
Restart hysteresis: pressure >2.5 bar; buffer >0.25 m; die <75 degC; work <2200 J; pitch inside 55..145 mm.
DI-271 = gate enabled AND clutch engaged AND no operator stop. DI-272 is the feed-complete latch, not an inspection status.
SIC-271.SP = 0 requests an operator stop; restoring the speed setpoint permits physical spinup and clutch reengagement.
An open clutch preserves partial crank work and any feed token. The flywheel coasts; no production tag is forced to zero.
Shaft envelope drives the encoder; traction and physical losses derive strip travel. Both admitted feed endpoints remain held.
Counter reconciliation: completed strokes = accepted + rejected + pending inspections; geometric trim is a separate material outlet.
Drive electrical power -> efficiency -> motor torque -> flywheel storage / forming work / bearing, guide and other losses.
Forming energy partitions to part energy and die heat. Oil rejects pump/bearing heat to ambient; water removes die heat.
CALC-WORK, CALC-SUPPLY and CALC-CONSUMPTION use measured instruments and retain their measurement uncertainty.
Mean-speed phase and energy-reconstructed tach are averaged approximations; energy-coordinate closure is not rigid-crank proof.
Exact 10 s delivery: classify each part from primary MEASURED QI-271 including gain/error/ADC; QI-272 is an independent check.
Journal code 3 records delivery / cumulative inspected count. Pulse position/speed: 16-bit acquisition, no level/flow dynamics.
Optical gauges: 10 um output increments, independent 50 um / 600 s thermal error; synthetic acquisition assumptions.
Operator .SP/.OP/.MODE: 0 MAN / 1 AUTO / 2 CAS. Speed-reduction event requests 90% of configured SIC setpoint, then restores it.
Conceptual only: no safety certification, relief/isolating/drain devices, line numbers, wiring, equipment or pipe sizing.
Circles: field/recorded observations. Rectangles: equipment and shared DCS controls. Internal MV names are actuator keys, not extra tags.
Thin solid gray leads attach observations to physical sources; equipment geometry and line routes are conceptual.
R7 | conceptual native press | verify against current source contracts
Units / range / signal meaning; no neighbouring-equipment tags
mm | -25..75 | Measured latched shaft travel minus strip pitch
mm | 0..250 | Independent last completed feed pitch
mm | -5..250 | Independent within-cycle shaft encoder travel
kN | 0..250 | Completed-cycle peak forming force envelope
N | 0..300 | Strip tension (native name; force units)
mm | 95..105 | Part dimension after 10 s transport
mm | 95..105 | Independent check of the same delayed part
- | 0..1 | Permissive AND clutch engaged AND no stop
rev | 0..1 | Mean-speed reconstructed crank phase, 0 to 1 revolution
J | 0..3000 | DCS work estimate from measured peak force
m/s | 0..0.3 | DCS copy of measured decoiler delivery
m/s | 0..0.3 | DCS pitch x mean speed x permissive estimate
L/min | -0.25..5 | Measured oil return/bypass branch flow
Tag metadata comes directly from tags.py; calibration, lag, scan and quality follow the native measurement/export configuration.
Historian quality: 0 good / 1 uncertain / 2 bad. Process relationships do not identify a scheduled event or a diagnostic answer.
